magic.name: Automatic Casting

description.text: Allows autocasting of spells. To activate it, use the buttons in the spell's tooltip. If you set a spell on Autocast, it will be fired automatically as soon as you have enough mana. If you have multiple spells in Autocast mode, the cheapest will be cast first. Later in the game, you will unlock more Autocasting options which will allow you to better manage your spells while idle.
While offline, spells are not cast. Instead, increase your mana produced amount by 10% of your Mana Regeneration per second.

requirements: Produce at least 50000 mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Improved Autocasting

description.text: Only while offline, increase your mana produced amount by 15% of your Mana Regeneration per second.

requirements: Produce at least 2 × 10⁶ mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Masterful Autocasting

description.text: Only while offline, increase your mana produced amount by 35% of your Mana Regeneration per second and increase Activity Time for spell set on autocast based on their duration, cost and your Mana Regeneration.

requirements: Produce at least 6 × 10⁶ mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Priority Autocasting

description.text: Allows you to prioritize the order of spell casting.
Spells with lower priority will be cast only if the higher priority spells are already active.
Only while offline, increase your spells cast amount by 1 per minute.

requirements: Produce at least 1.2 × 10⁷ mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Contingency Autocasting

description.text: Allows you to set a minimum amount of mana before starting to Autocast.

You can activate the Contingency Autocast by double-tapping the Mana bar. A golden arrow will appear. By sliding it you will set a minimum amount of mana below which spells won't be cast. Once your mana reaches the threshold, spells will follow the priority rules. The contingency loop will break when you can't cast a spell, at which point the cycle will reset.
Double-tap again to disable Contingency Autocasting.
Only while offline, increase your spells cast amount by 2 per minute.

requirements: Produce at least 2 × 10⁷ mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Planned Autocasting

description.text: Allows you to select Primary and Secondary spells to work with your contingency settings.

Primary spells (set with the silver icon in the spell tooltip) will fire once your contingency has reached its threshold. While these are active, Secondary spells (set with the gold icon in the spell tooltip) will be fired as soon as you have enough mana. If there are no secondary spells selected, the contingency settings will be the same as without Planned Autocasting. If there are no primary spells selected, spell casting will work the same as Priority Autocasting.
Only while offline, increase your mana produced amount by 10% of your Mana Regeneration per second, and your spells cast amount by 2 per minute.

requirements: Produce at least 3 × 10⁷ mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Efficient Autocasting

description.text: Allows you to select Independent Spells (set with the bronze icon in the spell tooltip) to work outside of contingency settings.
These spells disregard your contingency rules and are cast as soon as you have enough mana for them.
Only while offline, increase your mana produced amount by 10% of your Mana Regeneration per second, and your spells cast amount by 2 per minute.

requirements: Produce at least 5 × 10⁷ mana in this Reincarnation (before bonus multipliers)

magic.name: Reverse Autocasting

description.text: Allows you to manually reset spells. This command has a 2 seconds cooldown, and spells with a fixed duration cannot be reset.
Only while offline, increase your mana produced amount by 10% of your Mana Regeneration per second, and your spells cast amount multiplicatively based on your offline Mana Regeneration.
